title: 观光达人
concept: 金色旅行箱拿超大相机自拍打卡
revised_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: TripPet iOS achievement medal raster art for achievement_medal_travel_tier_003, to be converted into a transparent 768x768 app asset
Primary request: Create one absurd but premium collectible travel achievement medal for the Chinese title concept "观光达人" (sightseeing expert who mostly takes photos because a rich friend is around). The image itself must contain no text.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid #ff00ff chroma-key background for background removal. The background must be one uniform #ff00ff color with no shadows, gradients, texture, reflections, floor plane, transparency checkerboard, or lighting variation.
Subject: exactly one centered circular collectible medal, full object visible with generous padding. The medal has a chunky beveled gold rim and a glossy turquoise enamel center. Main visual gag: ONE shiny gold travel suitcase holding ONE oversized tourist camera pointed back at itself for a smug selfie. The camera is the only auxiliary object and should be large enough to read, but the suitcase remains the main character.
Style/medium: polished mobile game collectible, semi-3D hand-painted enamel pin / toy medal hybrid, playful deliberate nonsense, premium material finish, raised gold metal, glossy enamel, crisp edges, shiny highlights, not photorealistic.
Composition/framing: simple large readable silhouette, suitcase centered and dominant, camera clearly facing the suitcase like a selfie, full medal visible with generous padding, no cropping.
Lighting/mood: bright studio rim light, candy-like specular highlights, tourist-photo comedy, flashy but not cluttered.
Color palette: saturated metallic gold suitcase, electric turquoise enamel, black and gold camera, coral or ruby rim accents, white glints. Do not use #ff00ff anywhere in the medal or subject.
Materials/textures: raised gold metal, glossy enamel, lacquered toy-like surfaces, glassy camera lens, beveled rim, smooth hand-painted shading. No paper grain.
Text: none.
Constraints: no letters, no numbers, no Chinese, no labels, no watermark, no people, no animals, no maps, no compass, no leaves, no ticket, no neck pillow, no blanket, no airplane, no seat, no rocket, no globe, no gold bars, no coins, no money pile, no confetti, no postage stamp edge, no paper texture, no vintage scrapbook look, no cast shadow, no contact shadow, no reflection, do not create multiple medals.
